title: Credential
description: A verifier an account authenticates with, referenced by locator. No secret material appears in this schema or any instance of it.

method.description: How the verifier is checked. "api-key" is legal only for a service principal.

factor.description: Which factor this credential satisfies. A session is multi-factor when one of each was presented.

secret-locator.description: Where the verifier lives in the secret store. Never the verifier itself.

verified-at.description: When the principal last proved possession. Absent means never — the credential is unusable.

expires-at.description: When the credential stops being accepted. Absent means it does not expire on its own.

failed-attempts.description: Consecutive failures since the last success. Drives the account's "locked" status.

rotated-at.description: When this verifier replaced an earlier one. A rotation is a new record, not an edit.
